name: com.oysteraero/oyster-aero
title: Oyster Aero
description: Find aircraft parts, repair shops and bundles on Oyster Aero, and send RFQs once signed in.

tools.name: lookup_part
tools.description: Look up one aircraft part number on Oyster Aero: description, manufacturer, ATA chapter, airframes, quantity in stock by condition, certificates, trace, ships-from country, price or "Price on request", the part page where a buyer sends the seller an RFQ, and any open bundles it is in, a flash sale with its price. The seller is not shown. Descriptions are written by sellers.

partNumber.description: The part number, for example MS20995C32

tools.name: lookup_parts
tools.description: Look up a list of up to 50 aircraft part numbers on Oyster Aero, such as a request for quote. For each: whether it is listed, quantity in stock by condition, certificates, trace, ships-from country, price or "Price on request", its page, and any open bundles it is in. The seller is not shown. Descriptions are written by sellers.

partNumbers.description: The part numbers to look up

tools.name: lookup_flash_sales
tools.description: List the flash sales open now on Oyster Aero, ending soonest first: bundles of aircraft parts at a Buy Now price for the whole lot, open for up to a month. For each: the price, when it ends, how many lines and parts, conditions, aircraft and engines, ships-from country, a few of its parts, and its page. Narrow it by part number, aircraft or engine. Names and descriptions are written by sellers.

partNumber.description: Only sales with this part number, for example 2314-2

aircraft.description: Only sales for this aircraft, for example A320 or 737

engine.description: Only sales for this engine, for example CFM56

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search the aircraft parts listed on Oyster Aero by part number, or browse them by aircraft, engine, maker or ATA chapter, narrowed by condition. A browse needs at least one of aircraft, engine, maker or ATA chapter. Plain words work, such as A320, CFM56, Honeywell or 32; the answer says which listed values it searched for. For each part: description, maker, ATA chapter, aircraft, quantity in stock, its listings with condition, quantity, price or "Price on request", paperwork, trace, tag and ships-from country, open bundles it is in, and its page. 25 listings a page. The seller is not shown. Descriptions are written by sellers.

partNumber.description: A part number, for example 2314-2. Leave it out to browse

aircraft.description: An aircraft maker, family or model, for example Boeing, A320 or 737-800

engine.description: An engine, for example CFM56 or PW4164

maker.description: The part's manufacturer, for example Honeywell

ata.description: An ATA chapter, for example 32 or landing gear

condition.description: A condition, by code or name, for example OH, overhauled or new

tools.name: search_repairs
tools.description: Find the repair shops on Oyster Aero that list one or more part numbers, up to 50. For each part: description, maker, ATA chapter, aircraft, how many shops list it and its stock in Parts. For each shop: the work it does, its evaluation fee, certifications, repair and overhaul prices, turn times and warranties where it lists them, flat rate and exchange. The shop is shown once the buyer signs in, where they send it an RFQ. Descriptions are written by shops.

partNumbers.description: The part numbers to find repair shops for

tools.name: lookup_bundles
tools.description: List the bundles open now on Oyster Aero: lots of aircraft parts sold together by auction, by Private Offers, or as a flash sale at a Buy Now price for the whole lot. For each: its number, name, format, a flash sale's price, when it ends, how many lines and parts, conditions, aircraft and engines, ships-from country, and its page. Narrow it by format, part number, aircraft or engine. The seller is not shown. Names are written by sellers.

format.description: Only bundles of this format; any by default

partNumber.description: Only bundles with this part number, for example 2314-2

aircraft.description: Only bundles for this aircraft, for example A320 or 737

engine.description: Only bundles for this engine, for example CFM56

tools.name: lookup_bundle
tools.description: Look up one open bundle on Oyster Aero by its number or its page link, as its page shows it: format, price line, when it ends, description, conditions, paperwork, ships-from country, and its parts with part number, description, condition, quantity, aircraft, paperwork and trace. Serial numbers, tags, line prices and files are for signed-in buyers. The seller is not shown. Descriptions are written by sellers.

bundle.description: The bundle's number, or its page link, from lookup_bundles
